source_note: Planning basis: the current September batch sequence (including the previously supplied Batches 35–54 roadmap), the visible delivery records, the live Applications submodule inventory at 6478c2c5e0be7220aa06b290f4ce5874cad6b7bf, and the historical Umicom architecture/product documents. Batches 43–54 retain the earlier plan. Batches 55–88 are a proposed extension introduced by this consolidation, not previously completed work or a claim of prior approval. Historical batch/volume numbering is not silently renumbered into this series.

open_milestones.remaining: Host tools and selected installer/VM/media paths were delivered, but real graphical/physical boot and complete maintenance qualification remain separate.
Read-only build review and native export do not complete editor/debugger/Git or interactive designer authoring.
Paper/Live inspection is read-only; authenticated provider qualification and transmission/reconciliation remain open.
The delivery repaired build integration; it did not complete the expanded front-to-back TMS milestone.
Command review, close blockers and integrity checks do not complete products, real payments, exchange operations or authenticated approvals.
Selected evidence and citation inspection do not constitute qualified neural inference, scalable RAG or agent execution.
Dataset browsing and re-preparation do not complete a query editor, scheduler, external integrations or signed extensions.
PCM16 clip editing/export does not complete audio playback, video timelines, CAD, games or mobile builds.
This batch supplies native study planning and a curated 22-guide index. Expanded courses, verified practical execution and lesson package management remain open.

batches.title: Windows and GTK Integration Qualification
batches.planned_work: Compile and exercise the real GTK and Win32 adapters; clean-machine startup, private DLLs/resources, Unicode paths, unrelated working directories, DPI, accessibility and multi-window lifecycle.
batches.learning_project: Install Notes on a clean Windows account, deliberately remove a required resource, diagnose it and restore correct startup.
batches.acceptance_gate: Named Windows build and installed-product journeys; no missing or disabled tests hidden by a success label.

batches.title: Framework Lifetime, Cancellation and Concurrency
batches.planned_work: Audit owner/borrower contracts, callback lifetimes, worker join and shutdown, cancellation, lock ordering, event subscriptions and completion after window closure.
batches.learning_project: Cancel a Notes indexer and close the window while it runs; show that no callback touches a destroyed owner.
batches.acceptance_gate: Race/lifetime regression tests on the actual operating systems, alongside sanitizers and failure injection.

batches.title: Studio Editing, Debugging and Version Control
batches.planned_work: Finish document save/reload/conflict recovery, multi-project navigation, language-server actions, debugger state, registers/memory, terminal sessions, Git staging/compare/merge and exact test provenance.
batches.learning_project: Create a Notes project, fix a bounds error in the debugger, run its test, inspect and publish the intended change.
batches.acceptance_gate: One complete IDE workflow from new project to installed executable, including failed build and recovery paths.

batches.title: Visual Designer Editing and Round-Trip Generation
batches.planned_work: Connect palette, hierarchy, typed properties, events, bindings, responsive layouts and preview to the native exporter; review regeneration without losing handwritten source.
batches.learning_project: Build a Notes/account-summary window, regenerate it and preserve a handwritten command handler.
batches.acceptance_gate: The generated project compiles and runs; unsupported features are rejected rather than silently omitted.

batches.title: Market Recorder, Historical Data and Feed Recovery
batches.planned_work: Durable market capture, indexed ranges, corrections, depth deltas, separate event/arrival clocks, provider generations, missing segments and bounded backpressure.
batches.learning_project: Record a permitted practice stream, inspect a gap and replay an explicitly repaired dataset.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real capture adapter plus restart/replay consistency and data-rights review; reconnect is not represented as historical repair.

batches.title: Multi-Instrument Research and Reproducible Experiments
batches.planned_work: Multi-stream ordering, partial-fill models, rejected instructions, fees, run manifests, strategy-binary identity, seek/checkpoints, parameter grids and walk-forward experiments.
batches.learning_project: Compare two C strategies on frozen data, change costs, and separate training from unseen-period results.
batches.acceptance_gate: No-look-ahead checks, independent accounting and retained input/configuration/binary identity; no promise of profit.

batches.title: Identity, Secrets, Approval and Package Trust
batches.planned_work: Authenticated and revocable sessions, capability grants, secret providers, signed metadata, trust rotation, exact-input approvals, expiry and denial explanations.
batches.learning_project: Revoke an approval before a fictional transfer; reject a modified signed test package.
batches.acceptance_gate: Tampering, expiry, confused-deputy and key-rotation tests; required security fixes are pulled forward before any dependent action.

batches.title: Engine, Data and Risk Server Process Boundaries
batches.planned_work: Real supervised processes, bounded messages, deadlines, fenced ownership, durable inbox/outbox, retries, dead letters and dependency-aware shutdown.
batches.learning_project: Terminate an engine during a fictional trade workflow, then recover without duplicate postings.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual multi-process recovery evidence; clients never bypass Data Server to reach its database.

batches.title: Installer, Runtime Bundles and VM User Experience
batches.planned_work: Component registration, native update/repair/removal, shortcut ownership, signed offline releases, qualified QEMU bundle, path selection, console, graceful shutdown and disk-checkpoint inspection.
batches.learning_project: Install two applications and a VM component; repair one file, boot the guest and remove one application without deleting the other.
batches.acceptance_gate: Clean Windows install/maintenance and real QEMU tests; runtime redistribution is reviewed separately.

batches.title: Graphical Umicom OS and Persistent User Sessions
batches.planned_work: Boot a qualified graphical Linux profile using an established display stack, persistent user storage, session management, display/input configuration and an independent recovery route.
batches.learning_project: Save a note in the guest, restart and recover it; reject a bad system update.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual graphical boot and persistent-volume tests per claimed architecture; the kernel/recovery remain independent of Framework.

batches.title: Physical USB and Optical-Media Qualification
batches.planned_work: Stable device identity, system-disk exclusion, narrow elevation, explicit erase review, exclusive acquisition, flush/read-back, interruption handling and safe eject; optical burning qualified separately.
batches.learning_project: Start with a disposable virtual disk, then use an explicitly identified spare device and verify its boot route.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real supported hardware tests for wrong-device refusal, replacement/removal and incomplete writes. Device writes stay disabled until qualified.

batches.title: Integrated Release Candidate and Public Capstones
batches.planned_work: Freeze a named candidate and capability matrix; package version-matched examples, dependencies, known limitations, cross-application journeys and recovery tests.
batches.learning_project: Build Notes, replay research, reconcile a fictional financial workflow and boot the qualified OS.
batches.acceptance_gate: Reproduce the declared subset on a clean supported host. This is not a declaration that every long-term product feature is complete.

batches.title: Desk Federation and Cross-Application Sessions
batches.planned_work: Complete launcher/taskbar, application groups, deep links, cross-application context, notifications, window switching, session restore and controlled application management.
batches.learning_project: Resume a workspace containing Studio, Trader and a note without crossing account or project contexts.
batches.acceptance_gate: Restart and failed-launch tests preserve the correct application identities and session ownership.

batches.title: Shared Financial Reference and Money Platform Completion
batches.planned_work: Complete common money/rounding, currencies, calendars, parties, books, accounts, instruments, business dates, state migrations and reference-data governance.
batches.learning_project: Trace one fictional instrument and amount through all financial consumers without duplicate identity or rounding rules.
batches.acceptance_gate: Contract compatibility, independent arithmetic/calendar checks and controlled migration of existing practice data.

batches.title: Open TMS Front-to-Back Trade Lifecycle
batches.planned_work: Complete FX forwards, amendments, cancellations, deposits and loans, cashflows, positions, settlement obligations, accounting events and restartable end-of-day orchestration.
batches.learning_project: Capture, amend, value, settle and reconcile a GBP/USD forward through each owning service.
batches.acceptance_gate: Cash, positions and ledger reconcile after interruption at each lifecycle stage.

batches.title: Pricing, Portfolio Risk, Liquidity and ALM
batches.planned_work: Retained market snapshots, curves/calibration, sensitivities, scenarios, portfolio aggregation, cash ladders, liquidity forecasts and governed advanced-model adapters.
batches.learning_project: Explain a portfolio change from market inputs through valuation and liquidity exposure.
batches.acceptance_gate: Independent numerical references, deterministic populations, explicit missing data and stated model limits.

batches.title: Bank Products, Servicing and Lending
batches.planned_work: Account templates, deposits, interest, fees, holds, standing instructions, loan schedules, arrears, customer lifecycle and authenticated approval flows.
batches.learning_project: Open practice products, accrue interest, process a repayment and explain booked/held/available balances.
batches.acceptance_gate: Double-entry and restart invariants, permissions and explicit treatment of rounding and backdated changes.

batches.title: Payments, Statements and External Banking Adapters
batches.planned_work: Payment routing, cut-offs, message generation, acknowledgements, repair/reversal, statements, nostro/vostro reconciliation and separately qualified network adapters.
batches.learning_project: Follow a fictional payment through rejection, repair and matched statement confirmation.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real authorised test-channel evidence; a sent message is not treated as settlement and timeouts do not trigger duplicate transfers.

batches.title: Accountant Full Close and Financial Reporting
batches.planned_work: Charts and sub-ledgers, accruals, deferrals, depreciation, revaluation, budgets, consolidation, eliminations, period controls and reproducible statements.
batches.learning_project: Close a multi-currency practice group and explain each consolidation adjustment.
batches.acceptance_gate: Independent trial-balance/report checks; corrections preserve the original journals and approval history.

batches.title: Exchange Matching and Venue Operations
batches.planned_work: Expanded order types, partial matching, cancel/replace, auctions, session states, self-trade controls, surveillance, fee schedules and recovery of venue state.
batches.learning_project: Match a practice order book through a session transition and a restart.
batches.acceptance_gate: Deterministic price/time rules, independent book invariants and separation of matching from settlement.

batches.title: Trader Professional Workstation Completion
batches.planned_work: Integrated watchlists, richer charts/studies, Time & Sales, DOM/price ladder, positions/P&L, alerts, scanners, economic calendar and correct linked account/market contexts.
batches.learning_project: Investigate a market event across all linked panels while retaining source age and account identity.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual provider and graphical journeys; no fabricated live values or empty panels presented as completed features.

batches.title: Broker Paper and Deliberate Live Execution
batches.planned_work: Qualify the broker adapter, market subscriptions, orders/fills, cancel/replace, reconnect reconciliation, durable request identity, pre-trade risk, kill controls and execution audit.
batches.learning_project: Complete paper-order partial-fill/cancel recovery before a separately authorised restricted live acceptance procedure.
batches.acceptance_gate: Live execution needs explicit environment/account selection plus identity, risk, reconciliation and provider qualification. Existing Live access remains read-only until then.

batches.title: Local AI Runtime and Model Operations
batches.planned_work: Real local inference, model/provider compatibility, resource budgets, streaming cancellation, supervised workers, permitted accelerator paths and model inventory.
batches.learning_project: Run a small supported model, cancel a request and recover from provider loss without leaking resources.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual inference evidence kept separate from inert HTTP fixtures and extractive previews.

batches.title: RAG Ingestion and Scalable Retrieval
batches.planned_work: Versioned ingestion, chunking, embeddings, durable indexes, hybrid retrieval, reranking, source permissions, deletion propagation and navigable citations.
batches.learning_project: Index a changing Notes handbook and show which answer used which immutable passage.
batches.acceptance_gate: Scale and source-revision tests; citations are checked structurally without claiming automatic truth verification.

batches.title: AI Creator and Governed Helix Workflows
batches.planned_work: Resumable text/media jobs and reviewed tools; candidate source directories, bounded specialist workers, approved test execution and controlled promotion.
batches.learning_project: Generate a candidate Notes improvement, review its source diff and test results, then explicitly accept it.
batches.acceptance_gate: Models cannot bypass command authority, edit running production state, or push repositories automatically.

batches.title: Database Studio Operational Completion
batches.planned_work: Schema browsing, controlled query sessions, explain plans, paged results, parameter binding, migration review, backup/restore and supported database adapters.
batches.learning_project: Inspect a practice schema, run a bounded query and recover a failed migration through Data Server.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real database adapter tests, resource limits and preserved database authority; no application-local SQL engine.

batches.title: Integration Studio and Operations Execution
batches.planned_work: Mapping/flow designer, real connectors, scheduler, bounded retries, dead letters, replay, correlated service health, incidents and operational runbooks.
batches.learning_project: Recover a failed stock-list flow without duplicating its accepted records.
batches.acceptance_gate: At least one authorised real connector, crash/retry tests and business-level completion indicators.

batches.title: Security Centre and Marketplace Operations
batches.planned_work: Permission inspection, session revocation, trust-store management, signed package provenance, extension isolation, activation review and rollback.
batches.learning_project: Inspect requested permissions, reject a tampered extension and revoke its active capability.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual isolated-host and update paths with auditable outcomes; a manifest is not treated as a trusted signature.

batches.title: Media Studio Timeline and Video Workflow
batches.planned_work: Supported video/audio import, timeline trim, caption/title tracks, preview, render jobs, codec adapters, cancellation and new-file export.
batches.learning_project: Create and export a short captioned workshop clip while keeping the original assets.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual decodes/renders and independently inspected output; storyboard HTML is not labelled encoded video.

batches.title: Music Studio Playback, Mixing and Recording
batches.planned_work: Real audio-device playback, multi-track arrangement, mixing, metering, automation, supported recording, device changes and render/export.
batches.learning_project: Play a workshop tune, mix two tracks and export a checked result without blocking the audio callback.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real-device tests, callback lifetime/resource budgets and independent audio-format checks.

batches.title: CAD and Kitchen Designer Parametric Workflows
batches.planned_work: Measured 2D/3D geometry, constraints, snapping, units, drawing interchange, parametric cabinets, materials, dimensions and bills of materials.
batches.learning_project: Design a measured room and cabinetry, change one dimension and reconcile the material list.
batches.acceptance_gate: Independent geometric/unit checks, undo/redo and round-trip file tests; visual placement alone is not dimensional proof.

batches.title: Games Runtime and Scene Editor
batches.planned_work: Scene/entity lifecycle, input actions, animation, collision/physics boundaries, assets, save state, debugging and reproducible packaging.
batches.learning_project: Build a small workshop exploration scene with keyboard/controller input and saved state.
batches.acceptance_gate: Real frame/input tests and asset lifetime checks on declared platforms.

batches.title: Web Studio Native Runtime and Deployment
batches.planned_work: Server-driven UI, routing, forms, sessions, accessibility, static assets, realtime channels, API contracts and deployable host profiles.
batches.learning_project: Build and deploy a Notes web application backed by the same service contracts.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual HTTP/browser and permission/session tests; a visual HTML prototype is not a deployed application.

batches.title: Mobile Studio and Portable Application Profiles
batches.planned_work: Touch/responsive components, lifecycle, offline state, mobile build hosts, packaging, device permissions and supported native adapter boundaries.
batches.learning_project: Build a Notes profile for a named mobile target and recover it after suspension.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual supported-device/emulator journeys; required platform-language glue is isolated and justified.

batches.title: Education Studio Courses and Verified Practical Work
batches.planned_work: Expand the full beginner-to-advanced curriculum, prerequisites, versioned lesson packages, controlled practical runners, retained test provenance and instructor support.
batches.learning_project: Progress from a first C record to a tested, packaged Notes application and a financial capstone.
batches.acceptance_gate: Quiz credit, self-reported study and verified executable results remain distinct; no untrusted code is run without a qualified boundary.

batches.title: AuthorEngine, Bits to Banking and Public Documentation
batches.planned_work: Single-source manuals, public API/help generation, searchable offline books, examples tied to source versions, accessible assets and release-linked publishing.
batches.learning_project: Publish a chapter from the same tested source example used in Education Studio.
batches.acceptance_gate: Broken-link/example checks and explicit source/version/licence attribution; existing volumes retained rather than silently replaced.

batches.title: Native Compiler, SDK and Toolchain Productisation
batches.planned_work: Qualify native compiler/IR tools, toolchain discovery, installed C ABI SDKs, source-built dependency profiles, cross compilation and reproducible artifacts.
batches.learning_project: Build a small library, consume it from a clean SDK installation and inspect generated machine code.
batches.acceptance_gate: Language conformance and ABI/link tests; an experimental compiler is not claimed to replace a mature compiler before qualification.

batches.title: Multi-Frontend Component Conformance
batches.planned_work: Finish shared widget catalogue, layouts, accessibility and semantic conformance across selected GTK4, native web and justified Qt/wxWidgets/Wt adapter profiles.
batches.learning_project: Render the same Notes command/view model on two supported frontends without duplicate domain logic.
batches.acceptance_gate: Per-adapter compilation, lifecycle, input and accessibility evidence; no promise that every toolkit is already implemented.

batches.title: Digital Assets, Crypto Exchange and UmiCOIN Research
batches.planned_work: Networks, custody boundaries, deposits/withdrawals, finality/reorganisation handling, token supply, proof-of-liabilities and exchange/accounting integration.
batches.learning_project: Use an isolated test network to reconcile token movements and a deliberate reorganisation.
batches.acceptance_gate: No production keys or real funds by default; supported network/security and legal requirements reviewed before deployment.

batches.title: Clearing, Margin, Collateral and Custody
batches.planned_work: Clearing obligations, netting, margin, collateral eligibility/haircuts, custody movements, repo/securities lending and bounded default-management experiments.
batches.learning_project: Trace a practice cleared trade through collateral allocation and reconciled cash/securities settlement.
batches.acceptance_gate: Independent financial calculations and failure recovery; institutional CCP qualification remains a separate claim.

batches.title: Regulatory Reporting and Data Governance
batches.planned_work: Lineage, data-quality rules, immutable report populations, maker/checker submissions, acknowledgements, restatements, retention and jurisdiction adapters.
batches.learning_project: Produce a versioned practice report, reject a missing source and reconcile a restatement.
batches.acceptance_gate: Implement any real obligation from current authoritative rules at delivery time; no generic compliance certification.

batches.title: Umicom OS System Administration and Recovery
batches.planned_work: Processes, storage, networking, service control, user management, privileged-operation review, system installer, updates and rollback/recovery architecture.
batches.learning_project: Diagnose a failed service and select a known system generation without destroying personal data.
batches.acceptance_gate: Actual VM/system tests with narrow privilege boundaries and independently bootable recovery.

batches.title: Umicom OS RISC-V and Further Hardware Ports
batches.planned_work: Qualify RISC-V boot/userland, board support, device drivers, cross builds and selected ARM/other platform experiments.
batches.learning_project: Cross-build, boot and run a native Umicom lesson on a named supported board or emulator.
batches.acceptance_gate: Per-platform real boot evidence, ABI and device tests; portability headers alone do not count.

batches.title: Backup, Disaster Recovery, Scale and Resilience
batches.planned_work: Consistent backup/restore, migration recovery, retention, failover/fencing, stress/load baselines, resource limits and long-running failure campaigns.
batches.learning_project: Restore a practice estate and reconcile authoritative business and learning state.
batches.acceptance_gate: Measured recovery objectives, integrity checks and actual restore drills; sanitizer success is not universal race/leak proof.

batches.title: Accessibility, Localisation and Learning Usability
batches.planned_work: Keyboard/screen-reader journeys, high contrast, international text/input, locale-neutral storage, explicit display formatting and reviewed translations.
batches.learning_project: Complete a Notes and learning workflow using keyboard and assistive technology in two supported locales.
batches.acceptance_gate: Human and automated accessibility tests plus unchanged canonical financial/storage semantics.

batches.title: Whole-Portfolio Release Qualification
batches.planned_work: Close remaining gates, publish a supported-capability matrix and packages, freeze matched manuals and run installation, migration, interoperability and recovery capstones.
batches.learning_project: Reproduce the declared product suite from checkout through clean-host installation and published user journeys.
batches.acceptance_gate: Only evidenced capabilities enter the release claim. Unfinished domains remain visible in the next planning revision.
